function: Transcription factor and key regulator of the cellular response to oxidative stress. NFE2L2/NRF2 binds antioxidant response elements (AREs) and promotes the expression of cytoprotective genes involved in detoxification and redox homeostasis. It also contributes to the regulation of inflammatory responses.
biological_processes: regulation of cellular response to oxidative stress
positive regulation of glutathione biosynthetic process
molecular_functions: RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding
